notes: «وعن محمد بن يوسف حدثنا ورقاء ... عن مجاهد بهذا» is a second route for the same tafsir saying: its own group
«وقال عطاء قال ابن عباس نسخت هذه الآية» and «وعن ابن أبي نجيح عن عطاء عن ابن عباس» are a second saying (Ata on Ibn Abbas) with its own isnad: not written as a route; ruling for the owners (rule 11)
«زعم ذلك عن مجاهد» is ambiguous (a claim about Mujahid's words, not clearly a link): not added
the blessing-free text ends the saying at Mujahid, the last transmitter of the tafsir
